description: This file contains logging-related functions for the lighttpd server, including initialization, cleanup, writing logs with timestamp options, and splitting log lines.

methods.name: void li_log_init(liServer * srv)
methods.description: Initializes the logging system for the server, setting default log levels and creating string buffers.

methods.name: void li_log_clean(liServer * srv)
methods.description: Cleans up resources allocated for logging, freeing string buffers.

methods.name: void li_log_write(liServer * srv,liLogLevel log_level,guint flags,const gchar * fmt,...)
methods.description: Logs messages at specified log levels, optionally with timestamp, formatting the message and outputting to stderr.

methods.name: void li_log_split_lines(liServer * srv,liLogLevel log_level,guint flags,gchar * txt,const gchar * prefix)
methods.description: Splits a text buffer into lines and logs each line with optional prefix.

methods.name: void li_log_split_lines_(liServer * srv,liLogLevel log_level,guint flags,gchar * txt,const gchar * fmt,...)
methods.description: Formats a prefix string and calls li_log_split_lines to log each line.
